title: Clipboard Manager Legacy
description:
Clipboard Manager Legacy is a platform that you paste commands, folder, old reusable code on a profile and on click it gets copied to the user's clipboard.

It has the ability to copy all copied text on a profile at the clipboard, it also allows adding a copied text to the clipboard, before the clipboard which makes what's in the clipboard be replaces with (selected text + current clipboard and after (clipboard + selected text).
